from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tarfile


def _safe_members(archive: tarfile.TarFile, destination: Path) -> list[tarfile.TarInfo]:
    root = destination.resolve()
    members = archive.getmembers()
    for member in members:
        target = (root / member.name).resolve()
        if root not in target.parents and target != root:
            raise ValueError("archive member escapes destination")
        if member.issym() or member.islnk() or member.isdev():
            raise ValueError("unsupported archive member type")
    return members


def unpack(source: Path, destination: Path) -> None:
    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tarfile.open(source, "r:gz") as archive:
        members = _safe_members(archive, destination)
        archive.extractall(destination, members=members, filter="data")
    subprocess.run(["python", "-m", "compileall", "-q", str(destination)], check=True)
